text:
maria: heads-up: noticed a handful of tenants showing tiny positive deltas in console preview after the route enrichment rollout this morning
devon: noticed same, a lot of +0.01-0.03 token differences in preview vs ledger
alex: initial guess: enrichment fanout + retries are creating duplicate attribution events downstream
priya: any sample tenant ids? need to pull raw events
maria: tenant=greenfield-labs, route tag `feature=analytics`, preview line shows +0.03 tokens for 2026-03-18
devon: running clickhouse query now, `sum(tokens)` preview 214.03 vs ledger 214.00
alex: that aligns. small per-tenant delta but will aggregate across many customers
priya: do we currently dedupe on a stable fingerprint post-enrichment? I thought we used `fp=v1` header
maria: fingerprint exists but enrichment sometimes mutates fields used to compute it
devon: practical mitigation: console preview can apply a local dedupe step grouping by `(fingerprint, route_tag)` before summing, and flagging any recipe that changed fp
alex: longer term we should canonicalize fingerprint after enrichment (strip transient route attrs) so the dedupe key is stable
priya: agree. suggest rollout plan: canonicalizer service as a canary for 1% of traffic, compare invoice deltas, then promote if clean
maria: also add telemetry: `enrich.fp_outgoing` and `collector.fp_ingest` and a counter for `fp_mismatch`
devon: added quick proxy header `X-Fingerprint-Changed: true` when the fp value differs after enrich, will help backfill where mutation happens
priya: billbot, suppress noise: can we silence invoice-preview alerting for deltas < $0.05 for 48h while we investigate?
billing-bot: suppressing invoice-preview deltas < 0.05 for 48h. incident BB-5623 logged
alex: UX note: console should show a tiny tooltip: "preview uses best-effort dedupe during rollout; small deltas expected" and a link to status page
maria: action list: (1) quick console-side dedupe and tooltip (2) emit fp telemetry from enrich + collector (3) deploy canonicalizer canary (4) 72h monitor and backfill sample diff (5) decide rollback or promote
devon: ETA for 1 and 2 ~3-5 hours, 3 requires infra review, target tomorrow morning
priya: I'll open a ticket, tag `eng-platform`, `eng-sre`, `product`, include canary plan and backfill query
privia: (typo) meant to say i'll ping infra for canary infra
alex: small follow-up: run historical sample to compute weekly noise baseline so product can set sane alert thresholds
maria: good call. if anyone spots tenant delta > 0.10 ping here immediately. keeping thread open for updates
